notes.content:
Welcome to the next playtest build!
This update brings improvements across Cooking, Movement, Art, and Challenges.

## Patchnotes:
### Cooking:
Added: Stirring mechanic
Added: The AllDish
Changed: CookingGrid structure
Fixed: Cell texture bug

### Movement & Controls:
Added: Swimming animations
Added: Combo Meter system
Added: Grinding on rails
Fixed: Multiple ledgegrab issues
Fixed: Slow/stuck movement bugs
Improved: Camera & deadzone feel
Improved: Movement VFX

### Challenges:
Added: Dash, Twirljump, Double Jump, and more
Added: Challenge start/reset logic
Added: Challenge scripts + visual blockouts
Added: Slope & breakable walls

### Art & Visuals:
Added: NPC variant, godrays, rolling wave
Changed: Plate & water visuals
Changed: Skybox, fog, shaders, UI stars
Improved: Swimming & surf animations
Removed: Rigidbody from coins (performance issue)

### System:
Added: Settings menu
Added: Steam Cloud support
Changed: Player data handling in editor

notes.content:
A new playtest build has been released from the oven(our office)!
If you're wondering what changed and what is new, here are the patch notes:

Cooking:
[list]
[*] Added a functional inventory system
[*] The player can open a basic cooking station
[/list]

Movement changes:
[list]
[*] Added a Dash
[*] Added a Leap
[*] Added a Lunge
[*] Tweaked movement settings
[*] Fixed weird wall jumping
[/list]

World Changes:
[list]
[*] More islands with platforming!
[*] Added ingredients that you can pick up and add to your inventory
[*] Added destructibles
[*] Added functional signs that you can actually read
[*] Added a tutorial
[/list]

Surfing:
[list]
[*] No more jumping on water using the jump button
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*] Added an achievement
[*] Added gamepad overlay
[/list]
